nodes.label: Group-Level Jensen-Affected PPR Aggregation (SeaAroundUs)
nodes.rationale: Commercial/functional group SPPR exponentiates the group's catch-weighted mean trophic level once, rather than summing each taxon's own exponentiated SPPR. Because SPPR = 10^(TL-1) is convex, this is a direct, deliberate application of Jensen's inequality: group PPR can only ever be ≤ the sum of its member taxa's PPR, never more. The gap is kept on purpose — it measures the cost of moving from taxa to groups, which an Ecopath model cannot show on its own because it has no taxon level. In this 2019 EEZ release the understatement is 22.27% for commercial groups and 14.44% for functional groups; the top-level repository README reports a related but distinct 'globally' measured figure of 22.93%/16.48%.

nodes.label: Northern Humboldt1995-1998 geographic transfer
nodes.rationale: The 165,000 km2 northern Peruvian coastal domain extends 4-16 S and 111 km offshore; applying it to entire Humboldt LME catches is a substantial geographic limitation.

nodes.label: Northern Humboldt1995-1998 selection boundary
nodes.rationale: data/model_selection.xlsx selects Chiaverano 2018 and rejects Neira 2026; only 13_2 mapped, aggregated 13_3 outside scope and no new Chilean Patagonia mapping retained.

nodes.label: Northern Humboldt1995-1998 failed SPPR health
nodes.rationale: GE and With Egestion diverge; TE additionally fails input balance. A mapping validator cannot repair this. Gelatinous zooplankton imbalance, Chrysaora diet sum and sardine catch conflicts remain. Failed SPPR must not enter valid PPR coverage.

nodes.label: Northern Humboldt1995-1998 source membership precedence
nodes.rationale: Focal article and explicitly adopted Tam2008 examples control placement; no exhaustive residual inventory. Odontesthes regia and Labrisomus philippii remain Small demersal fish, Mugil cephalus Medium demersal fish, and Prionotus stephanophrys Sea robin despite SAU classes.

nodes.label: Northern Humboldt1995-1998 Peruvian hake stage weighting
nodes.rationale: Small/Medium/Large hake all represent Merluccius gayi peruanus. Printed lengths <29, 30-49 and >50 cm are retained. Unaged catch is split using constant model total-catch proportions including discards; southern hake and hoki are not this stock.
nodes.norm_label: northern humboldt1995-1998 peruvian hake stage weighting

nodes.label: Northern Humboldt1995-1998 coarse-taxon proportions
nodes.rationale: Clupeidae, Clupeiformes, Scombridae/Scombroidei and Teuthida use fixed proportions from identified catch within the same family/order; other aggregates use catch composition or explicit model_catch. Snake/cusk-eels are not automatically Conger.

nodes.label: Northern Humboldt1995-1998 mapping coverage
nodes.rationale: 218 decisions: high25, medium115, low30, unresolved48. 98.1854% of 677,999,683 tonnes mapped, 12,302,901 unresolved. Source checker confirms 21 taxa and 91.3% catch with zero contradictions; this is not numerical validation.

nodes.label: Northern Humboldt1995-1998 taxonomy regeneration invariant
nodes.rationale: All three SPPR scopes reproduce deterministic columns and missingness; only JSON taxon_descr changed. Monte Carlo output varies, including newly populated MC_new_GE cells, while every configuration still fails.

nodes.label: EastCoastScotland1991-1995 partial-LME validation boundary
nodes.rationale: East Coast of Scotland fishing grounds applied to all North Sea catch across 1950-2019 create spatial and temporal mismatch. Excluded from production selection and colored atlas pilot.

nodes.label: EastCoastScotland1991-1995 Table S2 membership
nodes.rationale: 25 taxonomy definitions and 124 member rows transcribed before mapping; printed spellings retained. accepted_name repeats source and does not imply nomenclatural verification; diet_import has no author membership.

nodes.label: EastCoastScotland1991-1995 Table S1 fleet landings
nodes.rationale: Table S1 G:I, rows 4-28, supplies 75 slots for Herring fisheries, Whitefish fisheries and Creels. The total is the sum of unchanged fleet cells, 3.4617151025401 t/km2/year, not independently rounded Total Catch J.

nodes.label: EastCoastScotland1991-1995 Table S3 diet matrix
nodes.rationale: Table S3 C3:Y27 has 25 prey rows and 23 consumers. All 575 slots, including 232 numeric cells, were verified. Consumer sums range 0.9996-1.0005 and source blanks remain blank. Source CSV and model.json are not normalised; the converter normalises ten columns by at most 0.05%.

nodes.label: EastCoastScotland1991-1995 unknown biomass accumulation
nodes.rationale: No numeric annual BA or migration is supplied. BA remains blank/-9999; across-century state change is not annual BA. Turbot and Ling reconciliation may reflect rounded B but adjusted values were not adopted.

nodes.label: EastCoastScotland1991-1995 loader transformations
nodes.rationale: The converter defaults habitat area to 1, normalises ten diet columns, zeros absent diet links/fates and leaves GS/BA unknown. The SPPR loader applies GS 0.2 except Small zooplankton 0.4, fills the detritus destination and solves BA during balancing. groups_df is a transformed computational model, not author measurements; LOADER_TRANSFORMATIONS.csv preserves provenance. Cross-model interpretation: Source-preserving metadata updates and numerical loader transformations both require separating author input from computational output.

nodes.label: EastCoastScotland1991-1995 deliberate source blanks
nodes.rationale: GS, BA, migration, detritus routing/import and habitat fractions lack source measurements. Inapplicable QB/PB/PQ fields blank. Authors excluded discards, not measured them at zero. No source import diet row supplied.

nodes.label: EastCoastScotland1991-1995 validation results
nodes.rationale: 650 spreadsheet slots, 25 group identities and 25 taxonomy descriptions were audited. Mapping covers 384 taxa with 14 composites and 62 unresolved: 99.597% tonnage mapped, 81.2% source-confirmed, 15.9% low confidence. Twenty methods returned and the 70-year PPR workbook was arithmetically verified without establishing spatial or scientific validity.

nodes.label: EastCoastScotland1991-1995 local extraction identifier
nodes.rationale: 20251990 is a deterministic local ID, not an EcoBase accession. Only the 1990s model was extracted. Gan 2025 Kuroshio-Oyashio Extension was not selected because supplementary diet + marks mean less than 0.01 and prevent exact reconstruction without author data.

nodes.label: Guinea1998 geographic transfer
nodes.rationale: The model covers 111,932 km2 off the country Guinea, beyond its EEZ; 43% is shallower than 200 m. It is not a demonstrated model of the full Guinea Current LME. The LME_028 transfer remains unvalidated until overlap and representativeness are established.

nodes.label: Guinea1998 ecological group axes
nodes.rationale: L/G means large, M medium, S/P small, inv invertebrate feeders and pred piscivorous/cephalopod predators. Coastal groups occur chiefly below 40 m, demersal groups at 20-200 m and bathyal groups beyond 200 m. These ecological assemblages do not require every taxon to be split geographically.

nodes.label: Guinea1998 Table 6 membership precedence
nodes.rationale: Full Table 6 yields 263 fish-member rows plus the explicit Cephalopoda definition. Printed names are retained with expanded initials and archived WoRMS crosswalks. Table 7 diet-study examples from other regions cannot establish membership; Table 14 historical fishery allocation cannot replace biological membership.

nodes.label: Guinea1998 Mulets and Dem M inv membership
nodes.rationale: Mulets contains non-mullets; Mugil curema is explicitly in Dem M inv and must not be moved to Mulets using its common name. Major tunas also include source billfish. Cross-model interpretation: The same common-name mullet intuition yields incompatible model-specific membership and unmatched-guild risk.
nodes.norm_label: guinea1998 mulets and dem m inv membership

nodes.label: Guinea1998 Solitas gruveli dual membership
nodes.rationale: Solitas gruveli is explicitly printed in both Dem L pred and Dem S pred; the unresolved source ambiguity is preserved.

nodes.label: Guinea1998 numerical provenance differences
nodes.rationale: Thirteen B/EE entries differ beyond strict printed rounding, mostly EE by less than 0.002 and B by less than 0.001; PB/QB match. Oiseaux source TL is 3.77 versus imported 3.545. Source diets and catch/discard reconstruction are approximate. Parameters were not silently corrected; input balance does not prove source fidelity.

nodes.label: Guinea1998 source-only deterministic ablation
nodes.rationale: Historical note describes a newly built isolated source-only baseline from untouched catch stub and Table6 exact/accepted names and genus unions. It is a bounded deterministic ablation, not a blinded independent-agent experiment, not a comparison of complete skills, and not evidence of accuracy gains from combining skills. Its earlier absence-of-A/B statement is historical, not a claim about later repository state.

nodes.label: Guinea1998 source-only ablation outcome
nodes.rationale: Source-only coverage is 52.2%, and group-set agreement is 53.6% of tonnage. The principal difference is the 32.3% unidentified marine fish catch apportioned across coastal/shelf residual guilds. This does not compare PPR methods or validate time/space applicability. composite_split accounting differs from member-validator coverage.

nodes.label: Guinea1998 mapping coverage
nodes.rationale: 375 rows and 43 composites; 165,272,510.790 of 167,652,883.904 tonnes mapped over 1950-2019, or 98.5802%. Catch confidence is high 41.487%, medium 23.634%, low 33.459%, unresolved 1.420%. Confidence remains conditional on model applicability.

nodes.label: Guinea1998 unresolved guild and habitat matches
nodes.rationale: Freshwater/brackish Sarotherodon catch lacks a documented source compartment. Unlisted Pentheroscion, Gobiidae, Mugil cephalus and others cannot be placed by family or habitat alone when feeding/depth guilds are ambiguous. Table 7 analogues are insufficient membership evidence.
nodes.norm_label: guinea1998 unresolved guild and habitat matches

nodes.label: Guinea1998 deterministic regeneration and Monte Carlo retry
nodes.rationale: Only taxonomy metadata changed. Deterministic SPPR values and missingness reproduce to 1e-9. The first MC_new_GE 180-second timeout was a runtime limitation, not biology. A 600-second retry completed in 449.60 seconds; all 20 methods succeeded, with 45 finite cells per scope and no lost finite values.
nodes.norm_label: guinea1998 deterministic regeneration and monte carlo retry

nodes.label: Karnataka2000 geographic transfer
nodes.rationale: 27,000 km2 Karnataka shelf model applied to whole Arabian Sea catch; mapping measures taxonomic join, not geographic representativeness.

nodes.label: Karnataka2000 source membership precedence
nodes.rationale: All 129 numbered CMFRI members were transcribed from printed pp.11-12/PDF pp.21-22. Exact model strings Skates & Rays and Micro Nekton remain. The source puts Thryssa in Clupeids, Bregmaceros in Anchovies, jellyfish in Micro Nekton, Plotosus/Fistularia in Benthic Omnivores, Parastromateus in Med Benthic Carnivores, and ponyfishes/Lactarius in Small Benthic Carnivores. Cross-model interpretation: Different taxonomic groupings require source member evidence to defeat plausible SAU habitat/size heuristics.

nodes.label: Karnataka2000 independent mapping re-derivation
nodes.rationale: No inherited_mapping row remains. Prior assignments were not inputs to new membership, definition and inference rules. 101 group expressions changed and previous notes were archived as superseded history. This is re-derivation, not blinded independent-agent testing.

nodes.label: Karnataka2000 limited nomenclature aliases
nodes.rationale: Formio niger was reconciled with Parastromateus niger and Loligo/Uroteuthis was corroborated. The alias column is not an exhaustive taxonomic revision. Caranx kalla remains without an uncertain synonym assertion.

nodes.label: Karnataka2000 same-lineage composite weights
nodes.rationale: Carangidae, Engraulidae, Siluriformes, Clupeiformes and flatfishes retain every documented compartment. Separately named catch does not exclude a taxon from an unidentified aggregate. Constant weights use identified catch only within the same family/order. Generic demersals include Benthic Omnivores at low confidence.

nodes.label: Karnataka2000 carangid size and diet analogues
nodes.rationale: Platycaranx chrysophrys common length 65 cm and Flavocaranx bajad 42 cm support medium-confidence Large Benthopelagics analogues despite misleading SAU size classes. Ferdauia orthogrammus feeding on sandy-bottom crustaceans supports a low-confidence Med Benthic Carnivores analogue. Model and SAU size classes differ.
nodes.norm_label: karnataka2000 carangid size and diet analogues

nodes.label: Karnataka2000 Harpadon nehereus uncertainty
nodes.rationale: Source lists Saurida but not Bombay-duck. Harpadon remains largest low-confidence analogue with benthopelagic alternative, never a verified source member; billfish/deep-ocean/unmatched reef herbivores unresolved. Cross-model interpretation: Harpadon placement changes from uncertain functional analogy to source-family containment across model definitions.

nodes.label: BayOfBengal1978 region 2 and 3 biomass weighting
nodes.rationale: Prefixed taxa split across 2 X | 3 X using model_biomass. groups_df biomass is already per whole-study-area, so ratios represent total standing stock. Cross-model interpretation: Both fix apportionment from one period over 70 catch years but weight different axes: geographic regions versus ontogenetic stages.

nodes.rationale: Biomass versus catch weighting raises taxon SPPR about 10-40%. The original all-region-2 mapping omitted region 3 and understated many demersal/benthic PPR estimates about twofold. Region 3 SPPR is typically 2-5 times region 2. Weight basis is the principal reviewable judgment.

nodes.label: East China Sea 1997 model
nodes.rationale: 47_1_East_China_Sea_(1997): 25 groups, 20 SPPR methods, all model catches zero; taxon_descr empty for all groups, so membership must come from the paper and supplements.

nodes.label: East China Sea 2018 model
nodes.rationale: 47_2_East_China_Sea_(2018): 25 groups, 20 SPPR methods; all model catches zero; taxon_descr empty. Selection notes say the 2018 model was used.

nodes.label: Estimating the Impact of a Seasonal Fishing Moratorium
nodes.rationale: Work-order selection lists Xu L, Song P, Wang Y, Xie B, Huang L, Li; usable yes, using the 2018 model. The abbreviated author listing is preserved as supplied.
nodes.norm_label: estimating the impact of a seasonal fishing moratorium

nodes.label: East China Sea coarse catch coverage burden
nodes.rationale: 80 of 276 labels above genus carry 86,710,138 tonnes, 30.7% of catch. Largest is Marine fishes not identified: 36,591,787 tonnes, 12.9%. The work order's near-78% coverage language is a generic historical warning, not a measured current mapping result.
nodes.norm_label: east china sea coarse catch coverage burden

nodes.label: Okhotsk NE mapping review notes
nodes.rationale: Review record for 52_1_Sea_of_Okhotsk_NE_(1980), covering source verification, taxonomy, mapping coverage, regeneration and method limitations.

nodes.label: Okhotsk NE model profile
nodes.rationale: Named stocks and families, residual habitat and feeding pools, plus juvenile/adult pollock; 1980s annual-average ecosystem, 29 source groups plus the algorithm import group.

nodes.label: Okhotsk NE Ecopath model
nodes.rationale: NE is an identifier for the detailed Ecopath model, contrasted with Shuntov-Dulepova SD; the source gives no formal expansion. Area is the whole Sea of Okhotsk, about 1,590,000 km² (Chaikina 2020 p.24), not a northeastern geographic restriction.

nodes.label: Chaikina 2020 Okhotsk marine mammal model chapter
nodes.rationale: A Model of the Okhotsk Sea with a focus on marine mammals, pp.23-34 in Pauly & Ruiz-Leotaud (eds.), Marine and Freshwater Miscellanea II, FCRR 28(2); based on the 2004 BSc thesis. Chapter source: https://epic.awi.de/id/eprint/52730/1/Palomares20_FishCentResaRep28.pdf
nodes.norm_label: chaikina 2020 okhotsk marine mammal model chapter

nodes.label: Chaikina 2004 BSc thesis
nodes.rationale: Original 49-page thesis was searched online; no readable copy or separate supplement was obtained.

nodes.label: Okhotsk NE source verification boundary
nodes.rationale: Whole chapter searched; Table 1 on printed p.26/PDF p.27 visually checked. All 29 source group names and numbers match after obvious spelling/spacing normalization. All 26 consumer B/PB/QB/EE rows match printed precision; producer B/PB agree by manual inspection. Detritus biomass is absent from Table 1, so the imported value is not source-verified. Rounded diet matrix inspected for guild meaning, not independently transcribed cell by cell.

nodes.label: Okhotsk NE documented membership gaps
nodes.rationale: Chapter supplies no species inventory. Header-only members.csv is deliberate; taxonomy.csv records taxonomic labels, residual definitions and explicit gaps. Archived WoRMS lookups support taxonomic interpretation, while common-name crosswalks, particularly Pacific Sardine, remain inference.

nodes.label: WoRMS lineage evidence for Okhotsk NE
nodes.rationale: Taxonomic lookups are archived beside the mapping; direct/genus candidates were checked as full sets and family unions against the member table with WoRMS lineage. Validation does not establish every candidate's ecological correctness.
nodes.norm_label: worms lineage evidence for okhotsk ne

nodes.label: Okhotsk pollock life-stage compartments
nodes.rationale: Walleye pollock and Juv. pollock are one species in two stages. The chapter supplies no age/length boundary or complete membership table. All model catches zero means species-level pollock weights use model_biomass; Gadidae and Gadiformes retain the stage split.

nodes.label: Okhotsk NE per-method numerical health
nodes.rationale: Input model balances and diets sum to one, but TE is numerically unsafe: living spectral radius exceeds one and negative sources occur. GE and With Egestion converge. Keep each method's health flag; catch coverage cannot rehabilitate divergence.

nodes.label: Okhotsk SPPR_1986 zero-output limitation
nodes.rationale: SPPR_1986 zero output is pre-existing. No algorithm or Jensen behavior was changed.

nodes.label: Okhotsk NE mapping coverage
nodes.rationale: 151 original catch rows preserved; 235,876,742.751 of 242,338,606.426 tonnes mapped in 1950-2019 (97.3335%); 11 composites. High: 50 taxa, 23.861% catch; medium: 37, 72.676%; low: 10, 0.796%; unresolved: 54, 2.666%. Confidence is conditional on model applicability. Blank weights request identified-catch composition unless model_catch or model_biomass is explicit; resolved.csv records the actual fallback.

nodes.label: Okhotsk NE source-incompatible catch taxa
nodes.rationale: No defensible general epipelagic/mackerel or elasmobranch compartment exists. Scomber 1,716,358.1 t, Cololabis saira 1,247,073.9 t, Scomber japonicus 883,031.1 t, Engraulis japonicus 546,075.0 t and Batoidea 375,866.6 t remain unresolved. Osmeridae 340,195.1 t cannot be collapsed into species-specific Capelin. Warm-water taxa and char/whitefish are not forced into incompatible stocks.

nodes.label: Okhotsk residual feeding-guild analogues
nodes.rationale: Shellfish and octopod residual placements are conservative guild analogues and low confidence where no species list settles the split. Generic demersal catch uses four broad bottom-fish groups.

nodes.label: Okhotsk NE SPPR regeneration verification
nodes.rationale: Taxonomy applied with tools/apply_taxonomy.py; exact names and seq coverage asserted. Named UTF-8 tools/run_sppr.py --in-place wrote the workbook. Comparable deterministic values across all three SPPR sheets match original within 1e-9 relative tolerance with no deterministic missingness changes. Monte Carlo differences are resampling; missing/negative values stay explicit. All invocations completed, which is distinct from per-configuration method health. validation.txt and regeneration.json retain evidence. Metadata-only changes to groups_df taxon_descr left all other worksheet cells and JSON non-taxonomy fields identical.

nodes.label: Okhotsk mapping work order
nodes.rationale: 1950-2019, 151 taxa, 242,338,606 tonnes rounded, two models, 20 SPPR methods each. Historical selection row says partial and ONLY NE is good; SD explodes for TE. Later review notes additionally establish NE TE divergence.

nodes.label: Okhotsk SD Ecopath model
nodes.rationale: 52_2_Sea_of_Okhotsk_SD_(1980) has 10 groups including import, 20 SPPR methods, zero catches and empty taxon_descr throughout. The work order warns SD explodes under TE.

nodes.label: Okhotsk NE taxon descriptions
nodes.rationale: taxon_descr is populated for 29 of 30 imported groups. Entries deliberately separate labels from species lists, distinguish scientific-name interpretations, and record not-documented gaps. Other Gadidae excludes pollock; Other mesopelagic fishes excludes Myctophidae and Bathylagidae. Carnivorous invertebrates eat second-level benthos; 2nd level benthos draws on phytoplankton, phytobenthos and detritus.

nodes.label: Okhotsk coarse catch work-order burden
nodes.rationale: 50 of 151 labels above genus carry 22,778,185 tonnes (9.4%). Marine fishes not identified is 14,223,073 t (5.9%). Generic near-78% warning is not the completed NE mapping's coverage.

nodes.label: Codex Ecopath Extraction interface
nodes.rationale: Display name Ecopath Extraction; short description Extract and validate published EwE models; default prompt invokes $ecopath-extraction with page-level provenance and validation.

nodes.label: Claude Ecopath extraction runtime requirements
nodes.rationale: numpy>=1.24, openpyxl>=3.1, pandas>=2.0, pymupdf>=1.24.

nodes.label: EwE import-file format contract
nodes.rationale: One stable directory per model identifier/name/year. UTF-8 without BOM, CRLF including final line, no quotes, exact template headers, contiguous consistent group numbers, source-printed number precision. Null/omitted JSON keys become blanks; zero remains zero.

nodes.label: EwE prey-by-consumer diet matrix
nodes.rationale: Diet_composition has prey rows and consumer-number columns, trailing Import, Sum and (1-Sum) rows. JSON diet is predator-keyed with prey-string keys plus import. Explicit row lists preserve intentional differences between full group list and prey/catch rows.

nodes.label: Ecopath model report and extraction-set index
nodes.rationale: REPORT.md requires source tables/layout, BA searches, prose derivations, conventions, deliberate blanks, conflicts and validation/mass-balance findings. MASTER_INDEX statuses complete, partial, excluded, pending must be updated with the model.
nodes.norm_label: ecopath model report and extraction-set index

nodes.label: Ecopath parameter conventions reference
nodes.rationale: Preserve the source parameter rather than deriving Z/PB, GE or TL to fill blanks. Blank, printed zero and analyst convention remain distinct. Software defaults explain consequences but do not supply source data.

nodes.label: Restricted zooplankton unassimilated-consumption convention
nodes.rationale: Use table GS first, then prose/stated assimilation complement, then explicit project convention. 0.4 only for unambiguously small zooplankton; 0.35 only unambiguous zooplankton-like groups. Ambiguous Zooplankton, Plankton, Invertebrates and Other pelagics stay blank. Project rules are narrower than EwE suggestions.

nodes.label: Biomass accumulation sign-convention review
nodes.rationale: Reference says negative BA is declining biomass but also says it raises printed EE relative to steady-state recomputation; its own later B(P/B)EE=Y+BA+predation equation makes that sign explanation inconsistent if other terms are held fixed. Preserve the stated negative-decline meaning and flag the explanatory sign discrepancy for review.

nodes.label: Ecopath parameter provenance categories
nodes.rationale: REPORT.md distinguishes tabulated, prose-derived, model-estimated and convention-derived values; any arithmetic and source locations remain explicit.

nodes.label: Coordinate-aware Ecopath PDF extraction
nodes.rationale: pdfgrid reconstructs columns from word bounding boxes using PyMuPDF with Poppler fallback. Render first, inspect raw coordinates, anchor on header numbers and then export. pdftotext -layout may silently move real numbers under wrong predators.

nodes.label: Anchored PDF diet-column reconstruction
nodes.rationale: Prefer numeric header anchors to prevent sparse columns disappearing. Match left/centre/right edges. merge_gap is about 2.0 pt for normal tables and about 0.4 for dense matrices (Azores/Mauritania); fused numeric cells require lower gap, split labels can be rejoined.

nodes.label: Rendered-page validation for numeric extraction
nodes.rationale: Preserve sources, rotate working copies and verify orientation. Inspect flagged numbers against page images at >=200 dpi; scanned/manual transcription uses 300 dpi and is reported. Re-extraction is not independent visual verification.

nodes.label: Ecopath prose and footnote extraction
nodes.rationale: Tables may omit parameters stated in prose. Resolve see text/voir texte pointers before reading cells; prose_sweep proposes passages rather than extracted values. Sweep whole chapter, then repeat with remaining blanks and group names.

nodes.label: Quantitative limits of prose-derived values
nodes.rationale: Scope every statement to specific groups. Entirely/exclusively yields diet 1.0; mainly/predominantly supplies no numeric proportion. Keep partial stated diets without filling residual. Distinguish discard share of catch versus of landings; record assimilation complements and unit arithmetic.

nodes.label: Table-footnote conflict precedence
nodes.rationale: Prefer table for tabulated data unless a footnote explicitly redirects to prose. Prefer methods for assumptions and explicit later/specific revisions when present. Record alternatives and choice; never choose what balances best.

nodes.label: Figure-derived parameter precision
nodes.rationale: Digitize only against labeled grids at 300 dpi, preserve one or two supported significant figures, do not extrapolate or read log axes by eye. Falling biomass implies negative BA. If one significant figure is unreliable, leave blank and report; derived slopes retain endpoints/year/arithmetic.

nodes.label: Ecopath table layout mapping
nodes.rationale: Read complete caption/footnotes, write header-to-field mapping before values, verify one row arithmetically, identify rows by name and count expected groups/consumers. This guards against pattern completion from prior tables.

nodes.label: Ecopath table structure and notation conventions
nodes.rationale: Join continued or column-block tables by prey label, anchor numeric header lines, preserve adult/juvenile subcolumns, transpose in code and merge wrapped names. Parenthesized estimates retain provenance; dashes/NA/trace bounds are not silently zero; blank diets preserve source convention.
nodes.norm_label: ecopath table structure and notation conventions

nodes.label: Ecopath source-unit conversion contract
nodes.rationale: Use source model area for absolute tonnes; kg/ha divides by 10 to t/km²; daily rates multiply by 365. Wet/dry/carbon conversion needs the paper's factor. Seasonal aggregation requires stated method. Log every factor; ambiguous units or layout remain flagged rather than guessed.

nodes.label: Coarse-taxon apportionment playbook
nodes.rationale: Coarse catch labels genuinely spanning groups should be apportioned instead of discarded; Unresolved is appropriate when the model has no compatible home. Historical baseline unresolved tonnage: Arabian Sea 21.8%, Bay of Bengal 22.3%, East China Sea 22.1%, under older table counts.

nodes.label: Evidence-constrained composite candidate sets
nodes.rationale: Apply documented source member placement and accepted synonyms before inferential taxonomy/habitat/size/commercial filters. Check every composite member even after validator acceptance. SAU class suggests center/adjacent size bands, not unrelated habitats; Other fishes & inverts excludes nothing. A split represents a genuinely broad taxon, not uncertainty about one correct home.

nodes.label: Constant composite weighting and fallback
nodes.rationale: Blank weights use identified-catch composition summed over the period. Weights stay constant across years so PPR=catch(taxon,year)*SPPR(taxon,method). For empty/circular composition use model_catch or model_biomass; fallback chain is model_catch -> model_biomass -> equal. Record actual basis. Explicit stated proportions and equal shares are also supported.

nodes.label: Composite mapping confidence contract
nodes.rationale: Medium for well-founded set with data-derived weights; low for wide sets/equal weights; high only for stated species composition. Never assign high when script computed the weights.

nodes.label: Taxonomic family unions and dedicated stocks
nodes.rationale: For family/order labels include all model groups with source-compatible members, including dedicated single-species groups inside that family plus appropriate general guilds. Batoidea cannot silently become Sharks. Mollusca may span benthic molluscs and cephalopods; Decapoda spans compatible crustacean groups.
nodes.norm_label: taxonomic family unions and dedicated stocks

nodes.label: Ecopath grouping-axis archetypes
nodes.rationale: Determine taxonomy, size/habitat, feeding guild, spatial/depth stratum and life stage before mapping. Record prefixes, stocks vs pools, catch-capable groups and source area relative to catch unit.

nodes.label: Feeding-guild model membership evidence
nodes.rationale: East China Sea guild groups need species lists, often in DOCX supplement; diet matrix constrains membership. Families spanning guilds require source-constrained composites; same TL can describe distinct diets.

nodes.label: Spatial-stratum composite weighting
nodes.rationale: Bay of Bengal prefixes represent subareas/depth; assigning all whole-LME catch to stratum 2 is a historical error. Taxa spanning strata use model_biomass when catch does not distinguish strata; restricted taxa use justified single strata, range names and unprefixed groups preserve source meaning.

nodes.label: Life-stage stock composite weighting
nodes.rationale: Species catch not separated by age/stage maps across stock stages. model_catch best captures selectivity when stage landings are given; otherwise model_biomass.

nodes.label: Catch-capable functional groups
nodes.rationale: Detritus and import cannot take catch; PP excluded except genuine harvested seaweed. Zooplankton, meiobenthos and microbial groups require evidence of actual landed fisheries.

nodes.label: Historical PPR Ecopath Atlas guide
nodes.rationale: Archived atlas architecture and scientific interpretation, superseded as active filesystem guidance by the region-first guide.

nodes.label: Atlas taxon catch basis evaluation
nodes.rationale: Landings, total catch and discards use separate taxon vectors; routing bands are landings-only, source-compatible scenario ranges rather than confidence intervals.

nodes.label: Atlas model group filtering
nodes.rationale: Subset selection retains original mapping weights, does not redistribute excluded catch or change NPP, and cannot rescue invalid methods. Precomputed sensitivity is unassessed for arbitrary subsets.

nodes.label: Annual fixed ecosystem cohorts
nodes.rationale: Stable complete-series ecosystem cohorts avoid spurious trends; comparisons intersect usable curves and baseline, but unlike map ratios do not recompute common taxon support.

nodes.label: Monte Carlo acceptance comparison gate
nodes.rationale: Acceptance below 80 percent removes a region from every comparison curve and its selected-cohort NPP; exactly 80 percent is eligible and missing diagnostics do not imply low acceptance.

nodes.label: Regional annual NPP and historical proxy
nodes.rationale: Annual ensemble availability does not mean full satellite coverage. Earlier-year proxies use the earliest value with provenance and never fill internal or later gaps.
nodes.norm_label: regional annual npp and historical proxy

nodes.label: Fixed atlas union NPP denominator
nodes.rationale: Dissolved union of 66 LMEs and 18 high-seas regions removes overlaps and excludes EEZ additions. Median is computed over union model totals; this coverage-limited reference is not world-ocean NPP.

nodes.label: Single carbon conversion for displayed PPR
nodes.rationale: Wet-weight PPR is divided by nine exactly once, while catch stays wet weight and NPP is already carbon; source workbooks retain original units.
nodes.norm_label: single carbon conversion for displayed ppr

nodes.label: Map common catch method ratios
nodes.rationale: Numerator and denominator share available catch taxa; failed configurations and negative source SPPR are excluded, while finite FAIL diagnostics remain inspectable.

nodes.label: Historical atlas integration plan
nodes.rationale: Immutable snapshots join the 167 selected ecosystems to geographically evidenced articles and verified files; proxy extent must not be portrayed as measured study extent.

nodes.label: September 4 LME retrieval report
nodes.rationale: Records 155 sources, 192 regional assignments and 45 unretrieved main sources. File validation, article identity, table completeness and successful Ecopath loading are separate evidence levels.

nodes.label: Historical atlas Python dependencies
nodes.rationale: Archived dependency ranges include openpyxl, pypdf, requests, beautifulsoup4, shapely, olefile and Pillow.

nodes.label: Historical unit ID integration spine
nodes.rationale: Legacy data directory joined differing upstream identifiers on unit_id and referenced bulk inputs; these locations are historical.

nodes.label: Separate model estimates and method spread
nodes.rationale: Distinct model periods, spatial domains and structures are not averaged. Method spread is informative; Jensen-affected grouped calculations diagnose aggregation bias rather than supply estimates.
nodes.norm_label: separate model estimates and method spread

nodes.label: Composite catch taxon apportionment
nodes.rationale: Coarse taxa spanning groups receive evidence-based composite weights; unresolved means unsupported model membership. Coverage is tonnage-based and group labels must match exactly.

nodes.label: Basal source partitions
nodes.rationale: All includes imports; inner excludes them; PP includes producers only. Methods lacking source decomposition remain blank rather than being copied into PP.

nodes.label: Annual NPP precedence and legacy scaling
nodes.rationale: Canonical annual regional values take precedence, including explicit missing rows, and are never scaled again; legacy 2019 fallback selects regional scaled fields.
nodes.norm_label: annual npp precedence and legacy scaling

nodes.label: Historical integration handoff and addenda
nodes.rationale: Historical evolving status and paths; later addenda supersede early counts, fixed-2019 denominators and the mistaken northeastern interpretation of Okhotsk.

nodes.label: Taxon aggregation Jensen distinction
nodes.rationale: Exponentiating weighted mean TL underestimates the sum of exponentiated taxon TLs; diagnostic aggregation rows are distinct from the preserved Monte Carlo Jensen correction.

nodes.label: Authoritative source member tables
nodes.rationale: Printed and accepted names plus genus unions detect mapping contradictions; source member tables can overturn plausible habitat/size assignments.

nodes.label: Ecopath grouping archetypes
nodes.rationale: Taxonomic, habitat/size, feeding-guild, spatial and life-stage structures require different mapping evidence. TL alone cannot establish feeding guild.

nodes.label: Named model SPPR execution boundary
nodes.rationale: The legacy exporter main block broadly overwrites saved outputs even for apparent help arguments; named-model wrapper calls the controlled runner. Monte Carlo results vary between runs.

nodes.label: Historical fixed composite weighting hierarchy
nodes.rationale: Mapping selects plausible candidate groups; legacy builder resolves weights using identified catch, model catch, biomass, then equal shares with recorded provenance; weights stay fixed across years.

nodes.label: September 11 historical integration completion
nodes.rationale: Dated integration evidence records annual NPP and all-366 simple-chain views, with model coverage and conversion-factor review deferred; historical test counts are not new checks.

nodes.label: Isolated Saygu 2025 pipeline validation
nodes.rationale: New extraction exercised the full computational chain but is not a production North Sea estimate; printed EE/accumulation issues and divergent TE remain documented.

nodes.label: Pilot model geographic and source identity caveats
nodes.rationale: Thailand's inherited 1963 filename carries 1980 values; Okhotsk NE is whole-Sea model variant; Guinea is a 111932 km2 subregion with source-version differences; local-to-LME applications extrapolate.
nodes.norm_label: pilot model geographic and source identity caveats

nodes.label: Configuration specific scientific publication gates
nodes.rationale: Failed diagnostics attach only to their tested solver configuration; any negative source group, including unfished groups, invalidates that method. Missing values never become zero.

nodes.label: September 11 consumer mean TE refresh
nodes.rationale: Archived refresh adds explicit consumption and catch mean variants using saved solved models, with protected non-mean values and frozen study inputs.

nodes.label: Consumer TE arithmetic mean
nodes.rationale: TE_i=(P_i/Q_i)*(1-M0_i/P_i); only regular consumers with positive weights enter, including zero-TE consumers. Consumption is Q, not Q/B; model weights remain fixed across years and display bases.

nodes.label: Catch weighted TE biomass fallback
nodes.rationale: Consumer biomass fallback requires every consumer catch weight to be zero; negative and positive weights cannot cancel to bypass validation.

nodes.label: Order dependent cycle subtraction
nodes.rationale: DFS removes smallest positive cycle flow repeatedly. SPPR_1995 prunes Z then renormalizes diets; Ulanowicz uses a diet zero-edge mask without renormalization, so these are not full repeated-recycling sums.

nodes.label: Mean TE refresh response compatibility
nodes.rationale: Current response package verifies frozen study hashes and non-mean cell identity; changed mean methods are removed and receive no new discard sensitivity.

nodes.label: Historical integration baseline tests
nodes.rationale: SeaAroundUs 47 and atlas 8 tests passed; calculator baseline retained 1 failure, 76 passes and 18 missing-fixture errors.

nodes.label: Historical integration final verification
nodes.rationale: SeaAroundUs grew from 47 to 185 passing tests, atlas stayed at 8, and calculator failures/errors were unchanged; structural and Jensen preservation checks are dated evidence.

nodes.label: September 5 integration implementation plan
nodes.rationale: Historical monorepo unification, manifest-based preservation, taxon-year catch distillation and retained Jensen-affected group estimates; plan code is specification evidence, not current implementation.

nodes.label: Annual catch distillation reproduction gate
nodes.rationale: Reuse standardize_catch per year and require the 2019 taxon slice to reproduce existing species totals before full historical distillation.

nodes.label: Historical group aggregation schema contraction
nodes.rationale: Keep group, matched catch, weighted TL, SPPR and PPR; migrate saved output columns deterministically so retained numerical values are unchanged.

nodes.label: Historical trophic level coverage assertion
nodes.rationale: Replacing dropped QA columns with tl_coverage_complete aims to turn missing historical TL catch into a hard failure; current migration still preserves historical gaps.

nodes.label: Historical equivalent agent skill distributions
nodes.rationale: Claude/Codex workflows were generated from shared extraction/mapping resources and checked as six matching packages; taxonomy sidecars are excluded from mapping discovery.

nodes.label: September 5 monorepo integration design
nodes.rationale: Historical design unifies five projects with unit_id joins; source catch archives are the only original annual taxon data, and canonical regional spine was then deferred.

nodes.label: Intentional group aggregation bias comparison
nodes.rationale: Group PPR keeps exponentiated catch-weighted TL to expose loss from grouping; exact taxon aggregation remains recoverable from species data and Monte Carlo Jensen behavior is unrelated.

nodes.label: Manifest based source preservation
nodes.rationale: Classify identical, differing and unique source paths before merging; explicit conflict resolution and value identity checks reduce accidental loss.

nodes.label: Discard report evidence preserving design
nodes.rationale: Embedded routing chart and tables retain invalid gaps and named omitted routes; hypothetical fractions never become observations and failed defaults show their reasons.

nodes.label: Frozen discard routing experiment specification
nodes.rationale: Private frozen engines and source models isolate routing changes; original living harvest H is fixed with D=fH and L=(1-f)H, and no source models are fitted by historical year.

nodes.label: Discard flow ledger scenario family
nodes.rationale: S0 reproduces saved baseline; SC retains H as fishery sink; SM moves D to M0 with dependent EE; SE uses distinct external sink; SR returns fishery mortality to an evidenced destination.

nodes.label: Coefficient boundary interaction decomposition
nodes.rationale: Paired fixed support separates changed SPPR, changed evaluated catch and their interaction. Their sum reconstructs total change; scenario ranges carry no assigned probability.

nodes.label: Native discard fraction experiment grid
nodes.rationale: Fractions 0, .01, .05, .1, .2, .3, .4, .5, .75, 1 are hypothetical uniform allocations of existing H; .75 and 1 are stress tests, and published fractions are only reference markers.

nodes.label: Pauly and Christensen 1995 reference
nodes.rationale: Original trophic-chain PPR benchmark cited by the discard study.

nodes.label: Versioned discard response production contract
nodes.rationale: Responses carry source JSON and workbook hashes, group identity, baseline coefficients, validity and permitted adjacent intervals; baseline plus exact persisted mapping weights must reproduce production coefficients.

nodes.label: Fixed landed taxon support for routing
nodes.rationale: Every positive supported landed taxon requires a valid scenario coefficient; missing support invalidates the whole route. Fixed mapping weights prevent implicit remapping.
nodes.norm_label: fixed landed taxon support for routing

nodes.label: Named route sensitivity envelope
nodes.rationale: Bounds require at least two valid named routes with no extrapolation or invalid-gap interpolation. Every included region needs assessed bounds for aggregation; NPP is held fixed and unsupported models remain unassessed.

nodes.label: Taxon resolved landings central estimate
nodes.rationale: All catch bases remain selectable, using their own reported plus unreported taxon vectors. Original source-workbook totals are coefficient audits, not downloads of the revised landings headline.

nodes.label: Completed discard routing findings
nodes.rationale: Study separates native coefficient sensitivity from regional catch-boundary effects and retains constrained-model, source and method validity limitations.

nodes.label: Humboldt source offal routing evidence
nodes.rationale: Documented source D/H is 3.996307735 percent; fleet returns go via Fishery offal to 10 percent pelagic and 90 percent benthic detritus. Loader loses these routes; several recycling methods remain invalid.

nodes.label: Chiaverano et al 2018 source publication
nodes.rationale: Primary Humboldt source and supplement support the offal route, not the hypothetical designated fraction.

nodes.label: Bay source catch and return uncertainty
nodes.rationale: 1978 source combines landings and discards but split and fleet destination remain unresolved; SM is a biological fate proxy, SR unavailable, and source domain differs from atlas geography.
nodes.norm_label: bay source catch and return uncertainty

nodes.label: Guenette BOBLME source report
nodes.rationale: Cited catch discussion p. 9 and Appendix A2.1 p. 46 in frozen recovered copy; source domain is 6205000 km2.

nodes.label: Guinea discard fraction and domain caveat
nodes.rationale: Assumed 30 percent of industrial landings is D/L rather than D/(L+D); it is not uniform total harvest. Detritus export is excluded from living harvest and source domain is not the whole LME.
nodes.norm_label: guinea discard fraction and domain caveat

nodes.label: Palomares West Africa 2004 compilation
nodes.rationale: Primary source cited at printed pp. 124-159, especially 149 and 153, for Guinea discard assumptions and domain.

nodes.label: Okhotsk zero harvest routing control
nodes.rationale: Frozen harvest is zero, making fH scenarios degenerate and unsuitable for regional uncertainty envelopes; NE identifies the whole-Sea model variant.

nodes.label: Chaikina whole Sea of Okhotsk chapter
nodes.rationale: Source chapter cited at printed pp. 23-34 for whole-Sea 1980s model context; original catches require additional evidence.
nodes.norm_label: chaikina whole sea of okhotsk chapter

nodes.label: Bay 2019 taxonomic boundary control
nodes.rationale: At frozen coefficients and NPP, landings PPR/NPP is 42.2575 percent versus about 43.71 for total catch; discards are 3.6664 percent of catch but 3.3186 percent of PPR, so regional catch fractions cannot scale taxon PPR.

nodes.label: Discard numerical protocol and diagnostics
nodes.rationale: 59 deterministic baseline comparisons pass documented tolerance; baseline normalization and inferred accumulation remain distinct from routing changes, and physical, numerical, method-conservation and source validity are separate.

nodes.label: Imported production denominator incompatibility
nodes.rationale: An all-source numerator with positive imported production cannot be divided by internal PP. Native PPR stays available and this guard does not change the satellite-NPP application.

nodes.label: Dependent detritus accumulation closure
nodes.rationale: Living P=predation+M0+fishery catch+external loss+accumulation+net migration; Q=P+egestion+respiration. Detritus accumulation is residual after fixed predation and sinks, so returned biomass is not assumed fully consumed.

nodes.label: Source catch export alias and detritus exclusion
nodes.rationale: Loader export and catch fields are aliases; detritus catches are zeroed, and Guinea detritus export enters accumulation rather than living harvest. Baseline inferred negative living accumulation is retained.
nodes.norm_label: source catch export alias and detritus exclusion

nodes.label: Explicit SR donor ancestry limitation
nodes.rationale: GE and egestion private equations carry donor ancestry; positive-fraction SR is unavailable for new_TE_EEfix because its direct-PP detritus scaling cannot represent donor returns.

nodes.label: PP equivalent export conservation diagnostic
nodes.rationale: New methods check sum(P_PP+P_Import)=sum((catch+accumulation+net_migration)*SPPR_all), modified for SE sinks and SR net exports. Discrepancy above 5 percent fails method conservation; Humboldt TE differs by 14.21893 percent.

nodes.label: Uniform catch weighting endpoint discontinuity
nodes.rationale: SC is invariant and SC/SE coefficients agree below f=1. At f=1, TEmean switches to biomass weighting and SPPR_1986 is undefined; interpolation must not bridge this discontinuity.

nodes.label: Frozen group identity UTF8 correction
nodes.rationale: 15 French labels were corrupted by legacy Windows decoding but numerical matrices use immutable sequence IDs. Public names come from hash-verified workbook sequence/name pairs with original labels retained in provenance.

nodes.label: Frozen discard sensitivity study archive
nodes.rationale: 197 immutable inputs retain verified bytes and source lineage; completed study has 3936 scenario records, 85960 group rows and 59 baseline comparisons. Public results remain distinct from production engine.

nodes.label: Isolated discard study reproduction
nodes.rationale: Verified environment, UTF8 loader, immutable inputs and versioned responses support reproduction; source audit retains PDF pages and supplement cells, while actual report browser verification was blocked.

nodes.label: Active ModelData and PPRCalculator user guide
nodes.norm_label: active modeldata and pprcalculator user guide

nodes.label: Humboldt original fleet discard routing
nodes.rationale: Original XLS supports fishery-offal routing for both fleets and subsequent 10% pelagic / 90% benthic detritus allocation; D=1.4202697425725 is distinct from hypothetical fH. No direct offal diet link or independent processing-offal source is established. Converted S0 does not restore fleet fates.

nodes.label: Bay of Bengal original catch and hypothetical return
nodes.rationale: 1978 catch combines landings and discards. Separate D and fleet destinations remain unknown. Generic-detritus return is hypothetical; source boundary is 6,205,000 km2.
nodes.norm_label: bay of bengal original catch and hypothetical return

nodes.label: Okhotsk zero recorded harvest and 1980s source
nodes.rationale: All frozen group catches are zero and original catch vector is unrecovered. NE means Ecopath model in the chapter, not a proven northeastern subregion. This cannot establish no real fisheries or invariance under positive discards.
nodes.norm_label: okhotsk zero recorded harvest and 1980s source

nodes.label: Guinea 1998 published discard assumptions
nodes.rationale: Table 16 has separate rounded D entries summing 0.090762, without precise complete D or recovered fleet fate. Approximate D/L=0.3 applies to specified industrial components, not uniform D/H. Detritus export 1670.48071 is excluded from living harvest.

nodes.label: Explicit fishery-return ledger without double counting
nodes.rationale: Designated return is represented once; replacing restored D by fH cannot add both. Biological M0 and egestion, external imports, detritus exports and fishing returns are different accounting flows.
nodes.norm_label: explicit fishery-return ledger without double counting

nodes.label: EwE catch mortality and discard-fate definitions
nodes.rationale: Catch equals landings plus discards; discard mortality, discard fate and biological detritus fate are separate inputs. Guidelines do not recover historical destinations or universal mortality fractions.
nodes.norm_label: ewe catch mortality and discard-fate definitions

nodes.label: Expanded experiment verified result inventory
nodes.rationale: 62,784 scenario records, 999,500 coefficient rows and 304,690 independent checks with zero failures; 34 focused tests passed. Saved-workbook differences were reproduced by raw-diet replay, not silently repaired.

nodes.label: Expanded twenty-model SM coefficient response
nodes.rationale: At f=0.2, new_GE median coefficient increase 0.9628% but retained-catch footprint median decreases 19.2298%; standard exceeds GE in only 5/20 cases. Model distributions are descriptive sensitivity ranges, not confidence intervals or global-population estimates.

nodes.label: Fixed-harvest SC SM SE SR experimental routes
nodes.rationale: H fixed; D=fH. SC leaves catch unchanged, SM moves D to M0 and decreases EE by D/P, SE moves D to external loss. Supported SR exists only for original Humboldt. Living physiology and predation held fixed; dependent detritus accumulation is accounting, not dynamics.
nodes.norm_label: fixed-harvest sc sm se sr experimental routes

nodes.label: Expanded cohort source-fidelity amendment
nodes.rationale: 20 model/time cases from 18 ecosystems, selected after 52 queued candidates from 252 inventoried JSONs. Four provisional cases excluded on source-fidelity grounds after scenarios; direction and magnitude were not selection criteria. Temporal pairs are dependent.

nodes.label: Expanded experiment recorded diet-rounding boundary
nodes.rationale: Raw consumer diet row deviation <=0.001 may be normalized with logging; source parameter adjustments beyond 1e-4 reject candidates. 49 saved-workbook differences match unnormalized diet replay.

nodes.label: Expanded full-discard endpoint stress diagnostics
nodes.rationale: No validity transitions at 0-20%; 100% may lose method support, invoke TEmean biomass weights or make SPPR_1986 undefined. Finite large flow coefficients near zero removal are stress diagnostics, not robust ecological forecasts.

nodes.label: Archived expansion fingerprinted model replay
nodes.rationale: Historical scripts run one heavy model per process and reuse completed work only when source, settings, fraction grid and code fingerprints match. Saved paths describe this archived experiment.

nodes.label: Exact-model retained-landings response contract
nodes.rationale: Match source hashes and immutable group identity; retain landings and mapping weights; apply /9; preserve invalid masks. Observed exposure is D/(L+D). Interpolation must not cross invalid endpoints or weight changes; central estimate stays landings-only.

nodes.label: Fixed annual NPP denominator for scenario comparison
nodes.rationale: Hold selected/global annual NPP denominator fixed across endpoints and include NPP choice, year, method, hashes and catch boundary in cache identity. NPP uncertainty is separate.
nodes.norm_label: fixed annual npp denominator for scenario comparison

nodes.label: Unsupported discard response remains not assessed
nodes.rationale: Selected-case responses do not authorize global donor proxies. Absent exact model support remains not assessed; interface is a proposal, not an installed production uncertainty layer.
nodes.norm_label: unsupported discard response remains not assessed

nodes.label: Amended detritus source-fidelity eligibility
nodes.rationale: Reject overwritten nonzero onward detritus fate and unsupplied negative accumulation financing consumption. Zero raw fate rows completed to identity are disclosed bookkeeping changes when DET M0 and egestion are zero.

nodes.label: Prespecified geographical candidate queue
nodes.rationale: EwE corpus first, geographic strata round-robin, then ecosystem type, size bin and numeric ID. No sensitivity magnitude, ranking or workbook availability affects ordering; original reference models and duplicate content excluded.

nodes.label: Prespecified numerical eligibility and resource guard
nodes.rationale: Require compatible wet-weight currency, physical closure, positive living harvest, finite nonnegative fixed standard and at least one convergent recycling method with PP gap <=5%. A >180-second baseline is resource-limited and unassessed, not scientifically invalid.
nodes.norm_label: prespecified numerical eligibility and resource guard

nodes.label: Archived total-consumption arithmetic TE mean
nodes.rationale: Consumer-only arithmetic mean retains TE=0 and weights by total Q=B*(Q/B), giving sum(P EE)/sum(Q). Read-only comparison did not change production; Canary failed balance and was excluded.

nodes.label: Archived zero-inclusive geometric consumer TE mean
nodes.rationale: Geometric mean is exp(weighted log TE); any positive-weight zero makes it zero. Tiny ETP roundoff-negative TE is zero only in this sensitivity. Geometric averaging was not adopted into production; finite classic SPPR fails for zero global TE above TL1.
nodes.norm_label: archived zero-inclusive geometric consumer te mean

nodes.label: Archived zero-catch biomass fallback fix
nodes.rationale: At the time of this report, production arithmetic averaging retained its existing catch cohort and changed only zero-catch fallback to consumers. This is historical evidence, not the later current consumption-default implementation.

nodes.label: Archived TE comparison model-balance eligibility
nodes.rationale: Nine of ten selected models pass saved and independently reconstructed underlying balance; Canary excluded. ETP substantial diet normalization is not scientific validation; SPPR configuration diagnostics are a separate gate.

nodes.label: Archived regular-consumer TE comparison cohort
nodes.rationale: Only Regular groups enter equal/catch/biomass means; TE_i=(P_i/Q_i)*EE_i. Catch is original model catch. Zero available catch means undefined catch mean without fallback, not unfished ecology. Thailand payload is 1980 despite 1963 filename.

nodes.label: Reconstructed Lindeman level-II-to-IV efficiency
nodes.rationale: Fractional trophic decomposition uses diet powers; level efficiency is predation-plus-catch divided by throughput excluding accumulation. II-IV geometric summary differs from arithmetic consumer means; reconstructed from official code, not an installed EwE executable.

nodes.label: Project minimum-flow cycle-removal sensitivity
nodes.rationale: DFS finds a cycle in stored order and subtracts its minimum consumption flow from each edge until acyclic, then renormalizes. Preserves net external balance; overlapping-cycle outcome can depend on order. Not identical to EwE optional cycle removal or a biological intervention.

nodes.label: Archived positive-TE conditional consumer means
nodes.rationale: Renormalize after excluding TE<=0, preserving any arbitrarily small positive TE. This changes estimand to positive-efficiency consumers because zero TE may be biological EE=0. No production outputs changed.

nodes.label: Archived TE weighting and cycle interpretation
nodes.rationale: No universal weighting direction. Karnataka equal/catch near20% versus biomass9.32%; retained cycles materially raise Humboldt and Okhotsk aggregate estimates. Historical10.13% is a different sample statistic, not calibration target.
nodes.norm_label: archived te weighting and cycle interpretation

nodes.label: Archived nine-model TE results table
nodes.rationale: Records arithmetic consumer equal/catch/biomass means and trophic geometric/arithmetic summaries under two cycle conventions. Canary excluded; East China Sea and Okhotsk catch weights unavailable.

nodes.label: Scotland-to-North-Sea spatial and temporal extrapolation
nodes.rationale: 1991-1995 partial-area model applied to whole North Sea1950-2019 in isolated test, not selected atlas estimate. Unidentified demersal candidates Flatfishes/Monkfish/Large Dem.fish are low-confidence inferred composition; unsupported taxa remain unresolved.

nodes.label: Scotland repaired-EE TE configuration failure
nodes.rationale: Default repaired-EE TE living spectral radius1.11278 fails; GE and With Egestion OK. Finite result is not convergence. Does not grade every TE-named method or Monte-Carlo accepted-draw subset; loader-transformed values are not author measurements.

nodes.label: Scotland unknown biomass accumulation audit
nodes.rationale: All25 groups have unknown BA, never source-observed zeros. Turbot and Ling EE discrepancies are indeterminate until source clarification, not confirmed extraction errors. Hypothetical negative BA would close residuals but is not inserted evidence.

nodes.label: Scotland marine-mammal and seabird P-over-Q warnings
nodes.rationale: Seabirds0.006, seals0.004, cetaceans0.002 lie below usual0.02-0.5 range; flagged for review, not automatically invalid. Detritus EE estimate is indicative with unknown BA omitted.
nodes.norm_label: scotland marine-mammal and seabird p-over-q warnings

nodes.label: Guinea source membership and geographic limits
nodes.rationale: 112,000km2 Republic of Guinea model is not entire Guinea Current LME or Equatorial Guinea. Groups combine taxonomy,size,guild,habitat; named oceanic/deep taxa cannot be excluded by generic coastal label. Exact source membership overrides coarse metadata.
nodes.norm_label: guinea source membership and geographic limits

nodes.label: Guinea composite catch-composition and biomass proxies
nodes.rationale: Fixed weights use identified-catch composition then model catch, biomass, equal fallback. Guild catch may include unrelated species; biomass is not fishing selectivity. Coarse residual rows and ecological analogues remain low confidence.
nodes.norm_label: guinea composite catch-composition and biomass proxies

nodes.label: Guinea unresolved freshwater and holocephalan catch
nodes.rationale: Five unresolved taxa: Sarotherodon galilaeus, Chondrichthyes, Cyprinidae, Inermiidae, Chimaeriformes. Sharks/rays representation does not support chimaeras, coarse marine metadata does not establish freshwater pathways. Unresolved is not zero.
nodes.norm_label: guinea unresolved freshwater and holocephalan catch

nodes.label: Guinea combined-arm joinability and validation coverage
nodes.rationale: 375 taxa; named groups join99.665235% catch, with37.247894% low confidence;56 composites carry41.395127%. PASS checks consistency and membership, not biological accuracy, non-inferiority or fully blinded validation.
nodes.norm_label: guinea combined-arm joinability and validation coverage

nodes.label: Active specific primary production requirement
nodes.rationale: Per-group basal-production requirement multiplied by catch yields PPR. Trophic-level family compresses food web to TL; network family traces basal sources and topology.

nodes.label: Active consumer-only arithmetic global TE means
nodes.rationale: All weights use Regular consumers and retain TE=0. Total consumption is default; catch variant uses consumer biomass fallback at zero consumer catch. Original method IDs now mean consumption weighting; weights stay fixed across annual atlas catches. Geometric sensitivities are not these methods.
nodes.norm_label: active consumer-only arithmetic global te means

nodes.label: Active GE TE and assimilation efficiencies
nodes.rationale: GE=P/Q; TE=GE*EE; With Egestion=P/(Q-egestion); global is scalar. TE options alter accounting, not interchangeable biological measurements.
nodes.norm_label: active ge te and assimilation efficiencies

nodes.label: Diet-recursive trophic level and detritus conventions
nodes.rationale: TL=(I-DC)^-1*1; source rows terminal. Classic methods break cycles and force detritus basal. Diet normalization can alter physical flow amounts and is not default in flow solvers.
nodes.norm_label: diet-recursive trophic level and detritus conventions

nodes.label: Classic 1986 and 1995 trophic SPPR formulas
nodes.rationale: 1986 uses common catch-weighted TL at TE0.1;1995 uses group TL;TL_fix interpolates integer-TL costs. Fractional exponential lies below straight-line blend by convexity.

nodes.label: Basal-source-normalized nullspace SPPR basis
nodes.rationale: A=DC/TE; basal rows become identity, nullspace of A-I normalized to one column per source. Algebraic finite solution alone does not establish convergent path sum.

nodes.label: EwE simple-path enumeration accounting
nodes.rationale: Enumerates simple paths, omitting repeated cycles. Optional focal EE cancels first-step EE only; intermediate EE factors remain. Cannibal-loop example separates simple-path from full cycle sum.

nodes.label: Ulanowicz pruned-diet nullspace method
nodes.rationale: Cycle-removal zero pattern prunes original DC without renormalization. Not generally equivalent to simple paths or all-cycle Leontief solution; agreement only acyclic under matching conventions.

nodes.label: 2015 Leontief living-network formulation
nodes.rationale: Detritus PP-derived contribution dissolved into living compartments, then inverse(I-A) sums paths if spectral radius<1. Production-normalized Z and DC/TE equivalent under stated TE definition.

nodes.label: SPPR_new numeric full-cycle source solver
nodes.rationale: Primary numeric solver uses full living-network nullspace and tunable explicit detritus treatment; unlike Ulanowicz does not prune cycles.

nodes.label: Detritus recycling fixed-point accounting
nodes.rationale: Single-pool x=a/(1-b), multiple pools(I-B)x=c. GE credits mortality with egestion diluting inflow; With Egestion attributes feces to prey via DC transpose; TE uses direct PP/import share without consumer recycling fixed point.

nodes.label: Detritus collapse openness and retention controls
nodes.rationale: Collapse never/auto/always trades detail for pooled approximation; pooling is not guaranteed to cure divergence. recycling_loss damps B, source_dilution also changes c toward external SPPR. External SPPR changes source term, not convergence gain.
nodes.norm_label: detritus collapse openness and retention controls

nodes.label: Single-detritus zero-EE PP re-credit
nodes.rationale: TE-mode EE=0 groups severed by zero denominator leak PP; correction re-credits consumed PP only for single-detritus TE. Near-zero positive EE singularities are not fixed.

nodes.label: Symbolic SPPR and imported-diet cost
nodes.rationale: SymPy counterpart shares detritus controls. as_DC infers imported-food cost from consumer internal diet; as_PP fixes source SPPR1. Neither is an independent measurement of imported upstream production.

nodes.label: Gamma TE Monte Carlo accepted-draw inference
nodes.rationale: Positive TEs sampled from gamma and clipped; nonpositive entries pinned. Reject negative results, optionally divergence failures; all rejected yields NaN. Accepted-draw means are conditional on clipping and rejection, not unqualified proof of unbiased expectation.
nodes.norm_label: gamma te monte carlo accepted-draw inference

nodes.label: Methods-reference Jensen expectation claim
nodes.rationale: Source claims higher unbiased expectation from convexity; unconditional extension to coupled nonlinear solves, clipped distributions and selected accepted draws requires review. Preserve claim as documented rationale, not a general validated theorem.

nodes.label: Configuration-specific SPPR diagnostic grading
nodes.rationale: Grades input balance, living rho<1, detritus rho<1, negative source columns and PP-budget gap. Living divergence invalidates detritus basis. Configuration verdict cannot grade every method of a model; footprint itself ungraded.

nodes.label: Convergence versus near-critical magnitude
nodes.rationale: Finite convergence is necessary but insufficient: near b1 magnification may be extreme. b_warn0.7 and detritus SPPR warning10 identify sensitivity, not empirical ecological validation.

nodes.label: Catch-weighted PPR with explicit source scope
nodes.rationale: PPR_s=sum(C_i SPPR_is), always one-row DataFrame. inner excludes imports; pp-only also excludes detritus. NPP is summed internal producer production; external-NPP mode unimplemented.
nodes.norm_label: catch-weighted ppr with explicit source scope

nodes.label: Within-system PPR-to-NPP budget ratio
nodes.rationale: Ratio uses inner PPR over producer production. Under balance denominator equals SPPR-weighted catch+BA+Nm. Above1 can arise from biomass depletion; source conventions and assumptions matter.

nodes.label: ModelData source tables and synthetic diet import
nodes.rationale: ModelData loads indexed groups, predator-by-prey diets,detritus fate and name lookup, adding synthetic import group. Source diet and mortality fate have different ecological roles.
nodes.norm_label: modeldata source tables and synthetic diet import

nodes.label: PPRCalculator completion defaults and LIM
nodes.rationale: Constructors complete missing flow equations; optional Linear Inverse Model optimization. Missing catch/BA defaults to zero and GS to0.2 are modeling choices, not extracted observed source values.

nodes.label: User-guide current mean-TE variant contract
nodes.rationale: Consumption and catch variants are consumer-only arithmetic means retaining zeros. Global weights default consumption; catch falls back to consumer biomass. Model weights fixed through catch years.

nodes.label: User-guide Ulanowicz same-answer claim
nodes.rationale: Guide calls pruned nullspace equivalent to simple-path sum; active methods reference explicitly restricts agreement to acyclic webs. Mark inconsistency for review.

nodes.label: User-guide fractional-TL overweighting claim
nodes.rationale: Guide says direct fractional power overweights omnivores, while methods reference convexity says it lies below integer interpolation. Direction of this explanation needs review.

nodes.label: User-guide outward-positive net migration
nodes.rationale: Defines net migration as emigration minus immigration, matching its production outflow identity; methods reference labels opposite sign while displaying same outflow equation. Sign descriptions conflict.

nodes.label: User-guide two convergence conditions
nodes.rationale: Living and detritus spectral radius must be below1; configuration and magnitude caveats remain. Diagnostics catch singular solves; guide elsewhere overstates never/auto robustness.

nodes.label: Chiaverano et al 2018 Northern Humboldt energy pathways
nodes.rationale: Original article and XLS supplement establish discard/offal provenance; discrepancies in sardine landings and fleet-row references remain visible.
nodes.norm_label: chiaverano et al 2018 northern humboldt energy pathways

nodes.label: Guenette 2013 exploratory Bay of Bengal model
nodes.rationale: Frozen62-page report is page authority; catch table combines landings and discards.
nodes.norm_label: guenette 2013 exploratory bay of bengal model

nodes.label: Chaikina 2020 Okhotsk marine mammal model chapter
nodes.rationale: 2020 chapter describes1980s baseline from2004 thesis; no catch column or complete recovered group harvest.
nodes.norm_label: chaikina 2020 okhotsk marine mammal model chapter

nodes.label: Guenette and Diallo 2004 Guinea 1985 and 1998 addendum
nodes.rationale: Correct Guinea chapter and1998 tables support specific source assumptions; neighboring country models cannot supply missing fates.
nodes.norm_label: guenette and diallo 2004 guinea 1985 and 1998 addendum

nodes.label: Pauly and Christensen 1995 historical 10_13 percent statistic
nodes.rationale: Arithmetic mean of140 trophic estimates from48 models differs from geometric within-ecosystem II-IV summaries; not calibration target.
nodes.norm_label: pauly and christensen 1995 historical 10_13 percent statistic

nodes.label: Official EwE network-analysis Lindeman reference
nodes.rationale: Source-code reconstruction includes default cycles-retained setting, not historical executable validation.

nodes.rationale: 1991-1995 model with author TablesS1-S4 and formula supplement; isolated North Sea extrapolation retains partial-area scope.
nodes.norm_label: saygu et al 2025 east coast scotland source

nodes.norm_label: ewe user guide ecopath input definitions

nodes.label: Methods-reference inward-positive migration wording
nodes.rationale: Labels Nm immigration minus emigration while equation treats Nm as production removal; compare outward-positive USER_GUIDE. Wording conflict is unresolved.

nodes.label: Claude eight EwE import tables
nodes.rationale: Basic_input, Diet_composition, Landings, Discards, Detritus_fate, Biomass_accumulation, TL and Metadata preserve the source model.

nodes.label: Claude exact functional group numbering
nodes.rationale: Group number and order coordinate every output table; changing order can shift diet columns.

nodes.label: Claude coordinate based PDF extraction
nodes.rationale: Word bounding boxes, caption and footnote review, explicit header mapping, and single-row arithmetic checks make silent column errors visible.

nodes.label: Claude prose and biomass accumulation sweep
nodes.rationale: Search prose twice and search BA before balance checks; qualitative trends do not provide numeric rates.
nodes.norm_label: claude prose and biomass accumulation sweep

nodes.label: Claude unknown value preservation
nodes.rationale: Unknown database fields remain -9999; unknown BA is not software-default zero. Derived absolute or rate counterparts are logged and habitat-area scaling is explicit.

nodes.label: Claude database JSON round trip verification
nodes.rationale: Database JSON is reconstructed from emitted import tables, so writer mistakes and manual edits are independently visible.
nodes.norm_label: claude database json round trip verification

nodes.label: Claude three mass balance verdicts
nodes.rationale: BALANCED, INDETERMINATE and NOT BALANCED distinguish failure from unknown BA. Verdicts describe the extraction and stay in reports rather than loader JSON.

nodes.label: Claude source faithful extraction principle
nodes.rationale: Preserve source precision, unknowns and provenance; never repair a reported matrix or fill a missing value to satisfy a numerical check.

nodes.label: Claude EwE defaults versus sanity ranges
nodes.rationale: Software defaults can act on blank imports, whereas sanity ranges only trigger review. Neither automatically becomes paper evidence.
nodes.norm_label: claude ewe defaults versus sanity ranges

nodes.label: Ecopath production balance equation
nodes.rationale: Production equals catch, predation, net migration, biomass accumulation and other mortality; omitted migration or accumulation can explain a residual.

nodes.label: Ecopath energy balance equation
nodes.rationale: Consumption equals production, respiration and unassimilated food, requiring positive respiration and P/Q below 1 minus GS.

nodes.label: Ecopath three of four parameter rule
nodes.rationale: Three of B, P/B, Q/B and EE are supplied and Ecopath estimates the fourth; systematic published blanks need interpretation rather than guessed values.
nodes.norm_label: ecopath three of four parameter rule

nodes.label: Other mortality rate versus calculator flow
nodes.rationale: Article M0 is a rate, while model.M0 is biomass times P/B times one minus EE; natural mortality may also include predation.
nodes.norm_label: other mortality rate versus calculator flow

nodes.label: Detritus pool and fishery flow accounting
nodes.rationale: Other mortality, unassimilated food and discards feed detritus; landings leave the system. Preserve source-specific fleet and fate allocation.
nodes.norm_label: detritus pool and fishery flow accounting

nodes.label: Polovina ECOPATH formulation
nodes.rationale: Reference identifies this origin but warns its bibliographic citations were not independently verified.

nodes.label: Christensen and Pauly Ecopath II 1992
nodes.rationale: Bibliographic details are explicitly from memory in the source and require verification before publication.

nodes.label: Christensen and Walters EwE synthesis 2004
nodes.rationale: Bibliographic details are explicitly from memory in the source and require verification before publication.

nodes.label: Per parameterisation source bundle inventory
nodes.rationale: Each distinct model receives its own source inventory; file role, model coverage, authority and page or cell location preserve provenance across formats.

nodes.label: Source authority and conflict preservation
nodes.rationale: Authority order guides investigation; disagreements retain both values and locations, and all assigned files are searched before declaring a field absent.

nodes.label: Archived source versus verified numerical use
nodes.rationale: Archived papers, selected articles, computational inputs, isolated validations and contextual citations are distinct evidence categories.
nodes.norm_label: archived source versus verified numerical use

nodes.label: Claude taxonomy to mapping evidence chain
nodes.rationale: Taxonomy.xlsx membership becomes database taxon_descr then groups_df explicit-member evidence; one source reading serves extraction and mapping.
nodes.norm_label: claude taxonomy to mapping evidence chain

nodes.label: Claude SPPR model health gate
nodes.rationale: Staged SPPR uses bounded repository wrappers. Timeouts and failures remain NaN; extraction success alone does not establish usable model health.

nodes.label: Claude extraction taxonomy SPPR mapping stages
nodes.rationale: Four model stages have separate deliverables; independent catch/TL or NPP work bypasses unrequested model stages.
nodes.norm_label: claude extraction taxonomy sppr mapping stages

nodes.label: Claude cross stage missing value semantics
nodes.rationale: Unknown model fields, blank mapping weights, Unresolved decisions and NaN SPPR cells have distinct meanings and are not numeric zero.
nodes.norm_label: claude cross stage missing value semantics

nodes.label: Claude catch tonnage coverage priority
nodes.rationale: Tonnage and taxon coverage differ; coarse labels may carry substantial PPR. A 95 percent coverage target motivates review.

nodes.label: Claude mapping evidence hierarchy
nodes.rationale: Explicit membership and synonyms outrank ecological analogues. Habitat, size, guild and TL jointly support inference; TL alone does not decide.

nodes.label: Claude source member table transcription
nodes.rationale: Capture species-to-group tables before mapping and distinguish direct, regional and inferred sources.

nodes.label: Claude mapping validation and integration
nodes.rationale: Validate complete taxa, exact model groups, weights, confidence and catch restrictions; integrate model and central workbooks only within scope.

nodes.label: Claude mapping examples are not cross region lookup tables
nodes.rationale: The historical examples had limited tonnage coverage and a stratification error; transfer their output shape rather than biological assignments.
nodes.norm_label: claude mapping examples are not cross region lookup tables

nodes.label: Historical mapping CSV contract
nodes.rationale: Original group strings are join keys; schema carries taxon, common name, classes, groups, weights, confidence, evidence and explanation. Current regional matching replaces this historical storage contract.

nodes.label: Historical fixed composite weighting bases
nodes.rationale: Original fallback used identified-catch composition, model catch, biomass, then equal shares, with weights fixed across years and full precision in Final mappings.

nodes.label: Mapping confidence and evidence codes

nodes.label: Membership source scope and precedence

nodes.label: Codex source membership and integration boundaries

nodes.label: Codex complete paper to PPR stage flow

nodes.label: Codex mapping source evidence safeguards
