nodes.label: Annual regional NPP integral
nodes.rationale: Annual regional tonnes C sum daily productivity times calendar-month days, spherical pixel area and polygon fraction; denominator for PPR.

nodes.label: Antoine–Morel reference product
nodes.rationale: Copernicus GlobColour monthly 4 km PP is the reference product; source document records STAC discovery, native anonymous downloads and units mg C m−2 day−1.

nodes.label: OSU MODIS R2022 algorithms
nodes.rationale: VGPM, Eppley-VGPM, CbPM2 and CAFE use the same MODIS R2022 input chain and 1/12 degree grid. Shared sensor inputs mean algorithms are not statistically independent.

nodes.label: Satellite water mask
nodes.rationale: Integration includes cells observed in any window-year month; never-observed permanent pack ice remains outside the conservative water area.

nodes.label: Hierarchical annual gap filling
nodes.rationale: Observed, polar-night zero, anomaly-rescaled pixel climatology and insolation-capped near-neighbour fill form central NPP. Far spatial fills remain separately reported upper-bound values.

nodes.label: Spherical cell area and fractional coverage
nodes.rationale: Exact cell/polygon fractions multiply spherical pixel areas; centroid membership is unsuitable along coasts; same-layer overlaps remain distinct.
nodes.norm_label: spherical cell area and fractional coverage

nodes.label: Common-mask model comparison
nodes.rationale: Algorithms share one 1/12 degree grid and jointly observed pixels for comparison; 4 km reference reduces by exact valid-cell 2×2 mean.

nodes.label: Baseline-scaled algorithm ensemble
nodes.rationale: Per-model annual estimate equals gap-filled reference baseline times common-coverage model/reference ratio. Sparse common coverage falls back to own-coverage ratios; no model retrieval remains missing, never zero.

nodes.label: Algorithm spread and shared-input uncertainty
nodes.rationale: The preserved 2019 report describes algorithm choice as dominant regional uncertainty; shared MODIS inputs mean the spread understates total uncertainty.

nodes.label: Overlapping marine region systems
nodes.rationale: LME, EEZ and high-seas areas overlap; summed region-system totals double count production. The documented recommendation is EEZ plus high-seas partition with explicit overlaps removed.

nodes.label: Optional first-order benthic production
nodes.rationale: Benthic add-on is off by default and does not affect core outputs. Shelf/light allocation has large uncertainty; mixing availability-weighted benthic with unweighted pelagic NPP mixes conventions.

nodes.label: Preserved 2019 NPP reference results
nodes.rationale: Reported 2019 totals are preserved reference results, not recalculated by this graph refresh. Later annual availability and production workflows are governed by the current annual documentation.

nodes.label: NPP configuration and shared paths
nodes.rationale: Relative raw, work and output paths resolve from the YAML file; shared data are under common_reference_data/npp. Configuration specifies 2019, its five-year window, three region layers, and the native baseline grid.

nodes.label: Central fill settings
nodes.rationale: Polar-night zero, climatology and nearest-neighbour fill are enabled; central estimate excludes far fill, near/far threshold is 200 km, and anomaly clipping is 0.5–2.0.

nodes.label: Five-algorithm ensemble configuration
nodes.rationale: Antoine–Morel is the reference among five models; 1/12 degree ensemble common-mask comparison uses a 5% water-area threshold before fallback.

nodes.label: 2019 preserved NPP summary
nodes.rationale: Preserved gap-filled Antoine–Morel central totals: LMEs 18.49, high seas 24.63, EEZs 27.82 Pg C/yr. These overlapping systems cannot be added. Reference output lists per-model spreads and limited-model regions.

nodes.label: Griffiths pooled runtime and return limitations
nodes.rationale: Detritus biomasses sum to 53.001775; prey fractions are summed, phytoplankton unchanged and pooled EE unknown. Runtime normalizes diets, supplies GS and zero defaults, sets detritus EE to 1 and replaces source BA=0 with approximately 416.710466. Separate fishery discard return is absent and gross removals are exported. This is a sensitivity model, not an exact steady-state source reproduction.
nodes.norm_label: griffiths pooled runtime and return limitations

nodes.rationale: Twenty-six unknown biomasses and 67 EEs were solved from author equations; original source remains unchanged. All three methods WARN, with all 846 group/scope/method coefficients finite and nonnegative. GS=0.2, detritus EE=1 and routing/defaults are explicit. Source diets were not normalized.

nodes.rationale: 147/349 taxa mapped; catch coverage 76.51% in 2019 and 78.85% over 1950-2019. Unsupported stocks remain unmapped. Fixed 2000-2014 food-web coefficients are applied across 1950-2019 catches; totals are partial, not whole-region estimates.

nodes.label: LME014 PAT2024 FalklandShelf native2020 selection
nodes.rationale: Native model has 36 groups, two fleets and approximately 200000 km2 of shelf to 300 m. Thirteen unknown biomasses were solved simultaneously with migration terms; positive biomasses and EE in [0,1] reproduce published precision. All methods WARN. The selected completed state reproduces 777 audited cells.

nodes.label: LME014 native detritus runtime caveats
nodes.rationale: Native fleet fate goes to Detritus while five consumers eat Discards. The loader loses fleet-specific supply, forces identity routing and EE=1, derives BA including negative Discards accumulation, and assigns unknown Detritus biomass placeholder 1. Source BA=0 is preserved.

nodes.label: LME014 printed and Ocampo candidate limitations
nodes.rationale: Printed-table variant is NOT_RUN because a one-detritus diet is not aligned with two final pools. Ocampo 1970 returns FAIL for all three methods with juvenile-hake inconsistency. Variants were not averaged. Native selected mapping covers 29/250 taxa and 65.31% of 2019 catch.

nodes.label: LME022 Scotland1991-1995 diagnostic evidence
nodes.rationale: Twenty-five groups. GE and With Egestion OK; TE FAIL with negative unfished Seabirds coefficients and living spectral radius 1.1127784. Source BA unknown; Turbot and Ling source balance indeterminate. Loaded normalization/default completion is conditional. Historical preference-only wording was superseded by the summary selection.

nodes.label: LME022 EcoBase457 unresolved flow-balance failure
nodes.rationale: Independent source balance passes while loaded flow checks fail. Discards68 stored P=0.2981897135 versus recomputed P=-99.7018102865, with source detritus import=100 and immigration=100. Source representation, loader and equation causes remain unresolved; debugging is deferred.

nodes.label: LME024 authorized normalized-diet fishery-return adapter
nodes.rationale: Fifty-four source groups plus synthetic Import. Canonical source unchanged. Donor removal is landings plus discards; discard returns enter group53 once and natural mortality/egestion enter group54, with ancestry and net-export accounting. No pooling. GE FAIL with PP gap30.131275%; Egestion FAIL5.173259%; TE returns unsupported-equation FAIL without coefficients. Later selected per summary.

nodes.label: LME024 printed accumulation and unresolved budgets
nodes.rationale: Printed BA rates multiplied by biomass give Discards BA=0.1 and Detritus BA=481.12. Shortfalls are 0.058682350475 and 307.289755896. Residual closing BA values were arithmetic demonstrations only and were not adopted. Maximum living production residual is juvenile Cod35.3771%.
nodes.norm_label: lme024 printed accumulation and unresolved budgets

nodes.label: LME024 nonfeeding basal import NaN basis failure
nodes.rationale: Four nonfeeding basal import NaNs in groups51-54 caused a KeyError for53/54 with basis nullity1. An isolated structural-zero convention changes only the returned runtime matrix; source blanks remain. This was neither zero seabird biomass nor a label typo.

nodes.rationale: The 1997 matrix does not establish realized 2018 diets. Endpoint diet/flow, BA, matching catches/native model and uncensored jack biomass are needed. Changed trophic levels indicate changed feeding. Visayan Sea is a local candidate, not the whole Sulu-Celebes LME.

nodes.rationale: GE OK, TE FAIL, With Egestion OK; strict SPPR balance false for all. TE has four negative basal-source columns despite living spectral radius0.546278<1, with balance gap0.0335435235. GE gap0.0067647981 and Egestion0.0038764796. Causal TE investigation remains deferred.

Loader normalizes83 cells, changes censored seabird B<0.01 to1 and PB/QB to0, and completes unknown detritus BA to1021.626599. These are unresolved loader artifacts, not additional authorized source repairs.

nodes.rationale: All six calls WARN, with zero negative sources. GE PPRall1985=433.7914973 versus2013=83.09784055 are loaded-model footprints, not regional annual PPR. TE EE=0 and near-zero warnings remain. Newer2013 selected;1985 retained for comparison.

nodes.label: Official publisher APIs and predecessor source search

nodes.label: Verified predecessor model lineage and compatible state

nodes.norm_label: verified predecessor model lineage and compatible state

nodes.label: Bounded online recovery without invented data
nodes.rationale: Use legitimate public/authorized access. Distinguish absent-after-search, inaccessible, incomplete and verified. After official/author/predecessor routes, record searches and missing fields; do not repeat failed routes indefinitely. Continue extraction and return NOT_RUN where prerequisites remain absent; residuals are not recovered data.

nodes.label: Four source canonical computational and loaded layers
nodes.rationale: Keep layers identifiable, preserving unknowns separately from defaults, derived parameters and authorized scenarios.

nodes.label: Source sentinels fisheries components and native equation bases
nodes.rationale: Crosswalk IDs/Sequence/names/stages/versions. Distinguish zero, blank, inequalities, rounded display zero, sentinel and placeholder. Preserve known discards with missing landings and check fleet sums. Track habitat/whole-area biomass, rate/flow BA, Z/PB, density and migration.

nodes.label: Native multistanza compatibility before causal diagnosis
nodes.rationale: Inventory links, transition ages, growth and stock-level BA. State target-equation support; translation residuals alone do not establish author-model errors.

nodes.label: Eight-import and canonical reconstruction field audit

nodes.label: Source-determined coupled unknowns before loading
nodes.rationale: Enumerate unknown B/PB/QB/EE, solve only determined source equations in separate computational input, verify rank/uniqueness/residuals/admissibility and independent or printed outputs. B=1 placeholders and free tuning are not source reconstructions.

nodes.label: Initializer transformation ledger and residual BA
nodes.rationale: Record changed known rates, censored-to-zero, biomass imputations, detritus EE=1, replaced or solved BA, normalized diets and synthetic groups. Loaded balance does not establish source steady state or observed stock trends.

nodes.label: Authorized variants conserve source and record assumptions
nodes.rationale: Keep distinct derived identities and existing authorization. Quantify diet deficits before normalizing, retain factors and recompute dependencies; tolerance differs from normalization. Pool compatible fields with a crosswalk, preserve totals, never average EE or derive fate from habitat shares.
nodes.norm_label: authorized variants conserve source and record assumptions

nodes.label: Four-part discard return conservation
nodes.rationale: Audit donor fishery removal, recipient inflow, recycling ancestry and external exports. Count internal returns once; natural M0/egestion fate differs from fleet-discard fate. A routing matrix may not represent all required accounting.

nodes.label: Persisted computational state and diagnostic reproduction
nodes.rationale: Retain source/derived hashes, exact loader options, engine identity and bounded reproduction. Reload persisted inputs and compare state, flows and requested diagnostics before coefficients are used.
nodes.norm_label: persisted computational state and diagnostic reproduction

nodes.label: Basal NaNs imports and basis-dimension troubleshooting

nodes.label: Full direct diagnose_sppr three-method contract

nodes.label: Exact audited constructor and execution record
nodes.rationale: Read source/runtime evidence and use candidate-specific audited settings. No silent defaults, normalization, new BA, pooling or repair. Save exact returns, hashes, settings, engine and state; keep interpretation outside direct-return reports.
nodes.norm_label: exact audited constructor and execution record

nodes.label: NOT_RUN exceptions unsupported FAIL WARN and OK
